newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National buys County Factors.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National buys County Factors.

text.p: British bank Abbey National Plc said on Thursday its finance house unit First National Bank bought British factoring company County Factors Ltd for an undisclosed amount.
Abbey National, Britain's fifth largest bank, said County's clients mostly comprised small businesses with a turnover between 100,000 stg and 3.5 million stg.
The company, based in Poole, Dorset, employs 15 staff. In the year to March 31, 1996, pre-tax profit rose by 20 percent to 646,000 stg and assets totalled 2.0 million, Abbey National said.
